female.sp: Zowort Heavy, F/D-20, standard heavy weapon loadout. Use the attached official front and rear views as mechanical design authority. Preserve dark olive armor, charcoal structural sections, pale gray joint discs, the low compact head-sensor motif, paired horizontal chest intakes and rounded polygonal shoulder housings. Preserve ONE long beam cannon mounted above her RIGHT shoulder and ONE rectangular four-cell missile launcher above her LEFT shoulder, with their actual backpack mounting supports; these are external heavy equipment, never wings. She holds the long black rifle in her RIGHT hand. The cannon, launcher, rifle and both feet must remain entirely inside the image, with generous margins. Keep the broad shoulder armor; expose collarbone, waist flanks and upper-thigh gaps between substantial fitted plates. Integrate the small orange optical sensor as a practical hair ornament without hiding the human face; no Gundam V-fin. Her straight crimson hime haircut has distinct cheek-length side sections and long back hair kept clear of the weapon mounts. Front-facing full-body portrait with face, chest and fronts of both legs visible. Pose otherwise freely chosen. No letters, model-number inscriptions, insignia, logos or background text. The first attached anthropomorphized image anchors the SAME adult woman, facial geometry, skin tone, green eyes and crimson hime hairstyle. Official front and rear views anchor equipment structure. Translate the entire illustration into the selected retro anime cel-painting language, including face, armor, weapons and background, rather than carrying over painterly or photographic surface modelling. Keep the selected front-facing view; limb placement may vary naturally without changing equipment.
